outcomes.budget_failure: Context-budget failure: the item was excluded by the budget although every included item was itself expected: the budget is too small for this question.
outcomes.policy_excluded: Authority/policy exclusion: an ineligible item was retrieved and excluded for the expected reason. Correct behaviour, not a retrieval failure.
outcomes.policy_mismatch: Excluded for a reason other than the expected one (a ground-truth or policy error).
outcomes.policy_violation: An item ground truth says is ineligible reached the context. Must never happen.
outcomes.ranking_failure: Ranking failure: the item matched but ranked below the per-kind retrieval cutoff (below_cutoff), or the budget filled with items ranked above it that the question did not require (outranked).
outcomes.recalled: Successful governed recall: an eligible item is in the context in its expected role.
outcomes.retrieval_failure: Retrieval failure: the item never matched the question (no_match), or surfaced only as a provenance link without matching it, which policy treats as not relevant (provenance_only).

baseline.description: Merged V0: distinct question terms matched (lower-case \w+ words, English stopwords, one plural 's' trimmed); ties newest first. Evaluated through `compile_context` itself.

baseline_provenance.description: Counterfactual context admission: the merged baseline plus one hop of relevance along citation and correction links.

exact_stem.description: Exact production-term matches first; Porter-stem matches only as a secondary signal (ties and texts with no exact match).

exact_stem_provenance.description: Counterfactual: exact_stem plus one hop of relevance along citation and correction links.

exact_stem_tiebreak.description: exact_stem without admission: stems only order texts that already match exactly, so the relevance gate stays the baseline's.

fts5_bm25.description: SQLite FTS5 (unicode61, no stemming) ranked by bm25(): weighting and length normalisation only.

fts5_porter_bm25.description: SQLite FTS5 (Porter stemming) ranked by bm25().

fts5_porter_bm25_aliases.description: fts5_porter_bm25 with the fixed alias map applied to questions and texts.

fts5_porter_bm25_provenance.description: Diagnostic: fts5_porter_bm25 plus one hop of relevance along citation and correction links.

porter_count.description: Baseline scoring (distinct terms matched) over Porter-stemmed tokens: normalisation only.

porter_idf.description: Porter-stemmed terms, each match weighted by its IDF: normalisation + term weighting.
